description: Max allowable anodic index difference (V) between two contacting metals, per MIL-STD-889 style design guidance. Use galvanic_anodic_index.csv. The more active (higher index) metal corrodes.
mitigations: Keep anode (active metal) area large relative to cathode area
Isolate with non-conductive washers/sleeves or sealant
Plate the cathode toward the anode (e.g. zinc or tin plating) or coat both
Avoid carbon fibre (CFRP) in direct contact with aluminium; use glass ply or isolator
